title: Mera Haq 39-Scheme Verified Dataset
description: Curated verified dataset of Central, State, and Institutional opportunities mapped by the Mera Haq deterministic engine.

schemes.name: AI Technocrat — IIT Dharwad
schemes.shortDescription: A PM-VIKAS free AI skill-development program for notified minority graduates at IIT Dharwad.
schemes.department: Ministry of Minority Affairs / IIT Dharwad

benefit.description: Free AI training, ₹1,000/month stipend, hostel where applicable, certification & placement support.
components: Free 1-year Artificial Intelligence Technocrat training
₹1,000/month stipend through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
Hostel & residential support where applicable
Government / SSC & IIT Dharwad certification
Post-placement support subject to scheme norms

verificationNotes: Selection is based on screening test / interview conducted by IIT Dharwad.
Seat quota is allocated across recognized minority communities including Jain.

requiredDocuments.name: Class 10 / Birth Certificate for Age Proof
Bank Account Passbook / Statement
requiredDocuments.note: Needed on official portal for DBT stipend

schemes.name: Maharashtra Minority Professional Education Scholarship / Support
schemes.shortDescription: MahaDBT fee waiver support for minority students pursuing higher technical and professional courses.

benefit.description: Up to ₹50,000 per year or actual tuition/exam fee waiver for professional degrees.
components: Tuition and examination fee reimbursement up to ₹50,000/year
Applicable for recognized technical/professional engineering and management courses
Disbursed through MahaDBT directly to institution/student

verificationNotes: Currently graduated in demo profile; qualifies immediately upon enrollment in higher studies (Master's/PhD).
Requires Maharashtra domicile and annual family income up to ₹8 lakh.

requiredDocuments.name: CAP Allotment Letter / Bonafide Student Certificate

schemes.name: Maharashtra PMKUVA (Pramod Mahajan Kaushalya Vikas Abhiyan)
schemes.shortDescription: State-funded vocational and advanced technical skill training across Maharashtra districts.

benefit.description: 100% Free NSQF-aligned skill training, assessment, certification and job facilitation.
components: Zero-cost short term skilling & technology courses
State government certification from Maharashtra Skill Development Board
Apprenticeship & employment placement support

verificationNotes: Batch enrollment is open through accredited MahaSwayam centers in Maharashtra.

schemes.name: PMKVY 4.0 — Future Skills & New-Age Tech Courses
schemes.shortDescription: Skill India initiative offering courses in Artificial Intelligence, Cloud, Drone Tech, and IoT.
schemes.department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)

benefit.description: Government-funded Industry 4.0 skilling and NSDC/Skill India digital certification.
components: Curated curriculum aligned with National Skill Qualification Framework (NSQF)
Hands-on labs and assessment by Sector Skill Councils
National Skill India Digital Hub credential badge

verificationNotes: Course availability varies by training partner and location.

schemes.name: PM-Vidyalaxmi Education Loan Support
schemes.shortDescription: Collateral-free, guarantor-free education loan pathway for premier Quality Higher Education Institutions.

benefit.description: Collateral-free, guarantor-free education loan up to ₹10 Lakh for top QHEI admissions.
components: Collateral-free and guarantor-free loan up to ₹10 Lakh
75% Credit guarantee support for loans up to ₹7.5 Lakh
Single-window digital application across scheduled commercial banks

verificationNotes: Loan is financing, not a cash grant. Requires admission to NIRF-notified top 860 QHEIs.

requiredDocuments.name: Admission Offer Letter from Notified QHEI

schemes.name: PM-Vidyalaxmi 3% Interest Subvention Scheme
schemes.shortDescription: 3% interest subsidy on education loans up to ₹10 Lakh for families with annual income up to ₹8 Lakh.

benefit.description: 3% annual interest reduction on education loan during the moratorium & course period.
components: 3% full interest subsidy on education loans up to ₹10 Lakh
Direct DBT credit into loan account
Open to students from families with income ≤ ₹8 Lakh not availing other subsidies

verificationNotes: Linked directly to education loans sanctioned under PM-Vidyalaxmi.

schemes.name: Minority Merit-Cum-Means Scholarship for Professional Courses
schemes.shortDescription: Central scholarship for minority students pursuing graduate and post-graduate professional/technical degrees.

benefit.description: ₹20,000/year course fee plus maintenance allowance of ₹1,000/month for hostellers.
components: Full course fee reimbursement up to ₹20,000 per annum
Maintenance allowance up to ₹10,000 per annum
Covering recognized minority communities: Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, Parsis

verificationNotes: Income limit is ₹2.5 lakh. If family income is higher, this does not match without income criteria adjustment.

schemes.name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj EBC/EWS Fee Support
schemes.shortDescription: Maharashtra state fee reimbursement for Economically Backward / EWS students in professional courses.

benefit.description: 50% tuition and exam fee waiver in government and private-unaided professional colleges.
components: 50% tuition fee waiver for eligible students in professional courses
Income limit up to ₹8 Lakh per annum
Admission must be through Centralized Admission Process (CAP)

verificationNotes: Requires active student status in an eligible CAP-admitted professional course in Maharashtra.

schemes.name: Dr Panjabrao Deshmukh Vasatigruh Nirvah Bhatta
schemes.shortDescription: Hostel and subsistence living allowance for Maharashtra students pursuing professional courses.

benefit.description: Up to ₹30,000 to ₹38,000 per year hostel subsistence allowance based on city tier.
components: Hostel living allowance for students studying outside hometown
Tier-1 cities (Mumbai, Pune, Nagpur): ₹30,000 - ₹38,000/yr
Income limit up to ₹8 Lakh per annum

verificationNotes: Requires proof of hostel admission or registered rent agreement during course.

schemes.name: Maharashtra Foreign Scholarship for Higher Studies
schemes.shortDescription: State financial assistance for Maharashtra students admitted to top 200 QS-ranked world universities.
schemes.department: Social Justice & Special Assistance / Higher Education, Maharashtra

benefit.description: Full tuition fee plus living allowance and economy airfare for Master's/PhD abroad.
components: Full tuition fee covered directly to international university
Living allowance in foreign currency for course duration
Economy return airfare

verificationNotes: Requires unconditional offer from top 200 QS-ranked global university in STEM/management.

schemes.name: PM-USP Central Sector Scholarship for College & University Students
schemes.shortDescription: Merit-cum-means financial assistance for students scoring above 80th percentile in Class 12.
schemes.department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education

benefit.description: ₹12,000/year for first 3 years of graduate study and ₹20,000/year at post-graduate level.
components: Direct DBT bank transfer of scholarship amount
Merit criteria based on Class 12 board examination percentile

verificationNotes: Income limit is ₹4.5 lakh. Requires active enrollment in a regular degree course.

schemes.name: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme (CSIS)
schemes.shortDescription: Full interest subsidy during moratorium period on educational loans for economically weaker sections.

benefit.description: 100% interest waiver during course period plus 1 year on IBA-approved education loans.
components: Full interest subsidy during moratorium period (course duration + 1 year)
Applicable for technical & professional courses in India

verificationNotes: Income ceiling is ₹4.5 lakh. Applied directly through the lending bank via Canara Bank portal.
schemes.sourceName: Ministry of Education / Canara Bank Nodal

schemes.name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Specially Abled Students
schemes.shortDescription: Scholarship for specially abled students (disability ≥ 40%) admitted to AICTE-approved technical degrees.
schemes.department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)

benefit.description: ₹50,000 per annum towards college fee, books, equipment and software.
components: ₹50,000 annual scholarship for every year of technical study
Disbursed through NSP portal via Direct Benefit Transfer

verificationNotes: Requires unique disability ID (UDID) or medical board certificate with ≥ 40% disability.

schemes.name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme
schemes.shortDescription: Financial assistance for orphans, children whose parents died of COVID-19, and wards of Armed Forces martyrs.

benefit.description: ₹50,000 per year throughout the technical diploma or degree program.
components: ₹50,000 annual scholarship for eligible vulnerable students
No ceiling on the number of scholarships awarded

verificationNotes: Specific eligibility: orphan, parent deceased due to COVID, or martyr ward.

schemes.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
schemes.shortDescription: Scholarship for girl students entering AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma courses.

benefit.description: ₹50,000 per year towards tuition fee and educational maintenance.
components: ₹50,000 per annum for female technical engineering students
Up to 2 girls per family eligible

verificationNotes: Dedicated exclusively to female candidates admitted into AICTE technical courses.

schemes.name: NAPS-2 Technology & IT Apprenticeship Pathway
schemes.shortDescription: Industry on-the-job apprenticeship with direct government stipend support under NAPS.
schemes.department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

benefit.description: Earn-while-you-learn industry stipend with government share up to ₹1,500/month.
components: Direct on-the-job training at registered IT & tech enterprises
Government stipend co-funding up to 25% (₹1,500/month)
National Apprenticeship Certificate upon completion

verificationNotes: Candidates apply to listed corporate apprenticeship vacancies across India.

schemes.name: PMEGP Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme
schemes.shortDescription: Credit-linked capital subsidy for setting up new micro-enterprises and technology startups.

benefit.description: Up to 25%–35% margin money government subsidy on project loans up to ₹50 Lakh.
components: Margin money subsidy: 25% (urban general) to 35% (special category/minority/urban/rural)
Project cost up to ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing, ₹20 Lakh for service/tech
No income ceiling for new enterprise project assistance

verificationNotes: Requires detailed project report (DPR) and bank sanction for new enterprise.

requiredDocuments.name: Special Category / Minority Proof for 35% subsidy

schemes.name: PM-JAY — Ayushman Bharat Health Insurance
schemes.shortDescription: Cashless health insurance of up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation at empanelled hospitals.
schemes.department: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare / NHA

benefit.description: ₹5,00,000 per family per year — cashless hospitalisation at 25,000+ empanelled hospitals.
components: Cashless treatment up to ₹5 lakh/year
Covers pre & post-hospitalisation expenses
All pre-existing conditions covered from Day 1
Portable across India — use at any empanelled hospital
No premium payment required for beneficiaries

verificationNotes: Eligibility verified via SECC 2011 database or state inclusion lists.
Download Ayushman card from pmjay.gov.in using Aadhaar.

requiredDocuments.name: Ration Card / SECC / BPL Certificate
requiredDocuments.note: Needed to confirm PMJAY beneficiary list inclusion

schemes.name: ESIC — Employee State Insurance Corporation
schemes.shortDescription: Comprehensive health insurance (medical, sickness, maternity, disability, death) for organised sector employees earning up to ₹21,000/month.

benefit.description: Full medical care for employee and family + 70% wage replacement during sickness + maternity benefits.
components: Full OPD, IPD, and specialist medical care for employee and dependants
Sickness benefit: 70% wages for up to 91 days/year
Maternity benefit: 26 weeks at full wages
Disablement and dependent's pension
Funeral expenses reimbursement

verificationNotes: Applicable to employees in ESI-covered establishments with monthly wage ≤ ₹21,000.
Employer registers the establishment; employee gets ESIC card.

requiredDocuments.name: Employment / Salary Proof
requiredDocuments.note: Requires employer registration in ESIC portal

schemes.name: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (Free Food Grains)
schemes.shortDescription: 5 kg free rice / wheat per person per month for all NFSA/Priority Household (PHH) and Antyodaya (AAY) ration card holders.

benefit.description: 5 kg free food grain per person per month (estimated ₹1,000+/month per family).
components: 5 kg free rice or wheat per person/month
Delivered through fair price shops (PDS network)
Applicable to all NFSA beneficiaries (Priority + Antyodaya)
Portable ration via 'One Nation One Ration Card'

verificationNotes: Requires valid Priority Household (PHH) or Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) ration card.
Beneficiary list maintained by state government Food department.

requiredDocuments.name: Ration Card (PHH / AAY)
requiredDocuments.note: Must be enrolled in state ration card system

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar seeding with ration card
requiredDocuments.note: Required for biometric verification at PDS shop

schemes.name: National Food Security Act — PDS Ration Card
schemes.shortDescription: Subsidised food grains (rice at ₹3/kg, wheat at ₹2/kg) for income-eligible families through the Public Distribution System.
schemes.department: Ministry of Food & Consumer Affairs / State Civil Supplies

benefit.description: Up to 35 kg subsidised grains/month per AAY family, or 5 kg per person for PHH.
components: Rice: ₹3/kg | Wheat: ₹2/kg | Coarse grains: ₹1/kg
Antyodaya (poorest families): 35 kg/month
Priority Household: 5 kg per member/month
State portability under One Nation One Ration Card

verificationNotes: Apply for new ration card at your state's civil supplies office or state portal.
Maharashtra: rcms.mahafood.gov.in
schemes.deadline: Apply any time at civil supplies office

schemes.name: PMAY-Urban — Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban)
schemes.shortDescription: Interest subsidy on home loans up to ₹2.67 lakh under Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) for EWS / LIG / MIG urban families without a pucca house.

benefit.description: One-time credit-linked interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakh on home loan (EWS/LIG). MIG: up to ₹2.35 lakh.
components: EWS (income ≤ ₹3L): 6.5% interest subsidy on loan up to ₹6L
LIG (income ≤ ₹6L): 6.5% interest subsidy on loan up to ₹6L
MIG-I (income ≤ ₹12L): 4% on loan up to ₹9L
MIG-II (income ≤ ₹18L): 3% on loan up to ₹12L
Subsidy amount credited upfront to reduce EMI

verificationNotes: Beneficiary family must not own a pucca house in India.
Female ownership / co-ownership preferred for EWS/LIG.
Apply through empanelled banks / housing finance companies.
schemes.deadline: Scheme ongoing — check pmaymis.gov.in for current sub-scheme

schemes.name: PMAY-Gramin — Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Rural)
schemes.shortDescription: Direct financial assistance of ₹1.2–1.3 lakh for construction of a pucca house for houseless and kutcha house dwellers in rural areas.

benefit.description: ₹1.20 lakh (plains) / ₹1.30 lakh (hilly/NE states) direct cash grant for house construction.
components: ₹1.2–1.3 lakh direct transfer for house construction
Additional ₹12,000 for sanitation (linked with SBM-G)
90–95 days MGNREGA labour entitlement for unskilled work
Free LPG connection under Ujjwala Yojana linkage

verificationNotes: Selected from SECC 2011 permanent wait-list (Awaas+) by Gram Panchayat.
Check your name on rhreporting.nic.in or contact Gram Sachiv.
schemes.deadline: Allocated by Gram Panchayat — apply via Awaas+ App
schemes.sourceName: Ministry of Rural Development / PMAY-G Portal

schemes.name: PM-KISAN — Direct Income Support for Farmers
schemes.shortDescription: ₹6,000 per year in three instalments of ₹2,000 directly to the bank account of small & marginal farmer families.

benefit.description: ₹6,000/year (₹2,000 × 3 instalments) as income support — direct bank transfer.
components: ₹2,000 per 4-month instalment (3 instalments/year)
Directly credited to Aadhaar-seeded bank account
No restriction on use of funds
Check status at pmkisan.gov.in

verificationNotes: Family must own cultivable agricultural land.
Institutional land holders, former/current constitutional post holders and income-tax payees are excluded.

requiredDocuments.name: Land ownership records / Khata
requiredDocuments.note: Khasra / Khatauni from revenue records required

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) — Agricultural Credit
schemes.shortDescription: Short-term credit up to ₹3 lakh at 4% effective interest (7% with 3% GOI subvention) for crop cultivation, post-harvest, and allied activities.
schemes.department: Ministry of Agriculture / NABARD / Commercial Banks

benefit.description: Credit limit up to ₹3 lakh at just 4% per annum effective rate (after 3% interest subvention by GOI).
components: Revolving credit for crop production expenses
Interest subvention: 7% rate – 3% GOI subvention = 4% effective
Covers post-harvest, household needs, maintenance of assets
ATM-enabled RuPay debit card for withdrawals
Personal accident insurance of ₹50,000 included

verificationNotes: Apply at nearest bank branch with land records.
No income / collateral required for credit up to ₹1.60 lakh.
schemes.deadline: Always Open at any bank branch

schemes.name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana — Crop Insurance
schemes.shortDescription: Comprehensive crop insurance against natural calamities, pests, and diseases at very low farmer-paid premium (2% Kharif, 1.5% Rabi, 5% commercial crops).

benefit.description: Up to full sum insured (as per state district notification) — covers yield loss, post-harvest, localised disasters.
components: Low farmer premium: 2% (Kharif), 1.5% (Rabi), 5% (horticulture)
Balance premium paid by Central + State Government
Covers standing crop, post-harvest losses, prevented sowing
Smart / remote sensing technology for faster claim settlement

verificationNotes: Notified crops listed per district before sowing season.
KCC holders enrolled automatically; non-loanee farmers can opt-in.

requiredDocuments.name: Land Records / Khasra for the season

schemes.deadline: Enroll before crop season cut-off at nearest bank / CSC

schemes.name: PM Ujjwala Yojana — Free LPG Connection
schemes.shortDescription: Free LPG cooking gas connection + first cylinder + stove to BPL women. Refills at subsidised/market price with first-cylinder free.

benefit.description: Free LPG connection (deposit waiver ~₹1,600) + first refill + stove deposit waiver (total benefit ~₹3,500).
components: Free LPG connection (security deposit waived)
First refill cylinder free of cost
Option for EMI-based repayment of stove / regulator
Subsidised refills via DBT thereafter

verificationNotes: Apply at nearest LPG distributor (HP, Bharat Gas, Indane).
Must not already have an LPG connection in the household.
schemes.deadline: Apply at LPG distributor any time

schemes.name: Saubhagya — Free Household Electricity Connection
schemes.shortDescription: Free electricity connection for BPL households and ₹500 for APL households in rural and urban areas under PM Sahaj Bijli Har Ghar Yojana.

benefit.description: Free connection cost (estimated ₹4,000–5,000 for BPL households).
components: Free household electricity connection for BPL families
5 LED bulbs + 1 fan for solar-powered connections in off-grid areas
5-year repair & maintenance for solar units
APL households: ₹500 in 10 instalments via electricity bills

verificationNotes: Contact local DISCOM/electricity board or nearest CSC.
Largely completed in most states — check connectivity status at saubhagya.gov.in.

schemes.name: Janani Suraksha Yojana — Safe Motherhood Cash Incentive
schemes.shortDescription: Cash assistance of ₹1,400 (rural) / ₹1,000 (urban) to pregnant women delivering at government health facilities to promote institutional delivery.
schemes.department: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare / NHM

benefit.description: ₹1,400 cash for rural BPL pregnant women; ₹1,000 urban. ASHA gets ₹300 (rural) / ₹200 (urban) as performance incentive.
components: ₹1,400 cash assistance for rural BPL pregnant women
₹1,000 for urban BPL women delivering at govt facility
Covers all pregnancies (no restriction on birth order in low-performing states)
ASHA facilitator provides doorstep support

verificationNotes: Deliver at government health facility or accredited private hospital.
Register with ASHA worker or sub-centre early in pregnancy.

requiredDocuments.name: MCH (Mother Child Health) Card
requiredDocuments.note: Obtain from sub-centre / PHC at pregnancy registration

schemes.deadline: Register during pregnancy — delivery must be institutional

schemes.name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) — Maternity Benefit
schemes.shortDescription: ₹5,000 maternity benefit in two instalments for the first living child, and ₹6,000 for the second child if it's a girl — promoting early antenatal care.

benefit.description: ₹5,000 in 2 instalments for first child; ₹6,000 one-time for second child (if girl).
components: 1st instalment ₹3,000: on early pregnancy registration (within 150 days)
2nd instalment ₹2,000: after delivery and first vaccination
2nd child benefit ₹6,000: one-time if child is a girl
DBT direct to mother's bank account

verificationNotes: Apply via Anganwadi Centre or health sub-centre within 150 days of last menstrual period.
Available at pmmvy-cas.nic.in or WCD district office.
schemes.deadline: Register within 150 days of last menstrual period

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana — Girl Child Savings Scheme
schemes.shortDescription: High-interest (currently 8.2% p.a.) tax-free savings account for a girl child (below 10 years) with deduction under 80C. Matures after 21 years.
schemes.department: Ministry of Finance / India Post / Banks

benefit.description: 8.2% p.a. interest (tax-free) — highest among small savings schemes. 80C tax benefit on deposits.
components: 8.2% interest per annum (compounded yearly) — among highest safe savings rates
Income tax deduction up to ₹1.5L under Section 80C
Partial withdrawal (50%) allowed at age 18 for education
Minimum deposit ₹250/year, maximum ₹1.5L/year
Account matures after 21 years (or on marriage after 18)

verificationNotes: Parent / guardian opens account at Post Office or designated bank.
One account per girl child, max 2 accounts per family.
schemes.deadline: Open before girl child turns 10 years of age

schemes.name: MGNREGA — Guaranteed Rural Employment Job Card
schemes.shortDescription: 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per household per year at government-notified wage rates (₹220–400/day depending on state) for rural adult workers.

benefit.description: 100 days guaranteed work per year at ~₹220–400/day (state-specific MGNREGA wage rate).
components: 100 days guaranteed wage employment per household
Work allocated within 15 days of application or unemployment allowance
Wages deposited in bank / post office accounts
Additional days in drought / natural calamity notified years
Women: minimum 1/3rd participation mandated

verificationNotes: Enroll for Job Card at Gram Panchayat. Free of cost.
Demand work in writing to Gram Panchayat; work must start within 15 days.

requiredDocuments.name: Job Card Application (free at Gram Panchayat)

schemes.deadline: Apply at Gram Panchayat any time

schemes.name: PM SVANidhi — Street Vendor Micro-Credit Loan
schemes.shortDescription: Collateral-free working capital loans of ₹10,000 → ₹20,000 → ₹50,000 for street vendors, with 7% interest subvention and digital transaction incentives.

benefit.description: ₹10,000 (Tier 1) → ₹20,000 (Tier 2) → ₹50,000 (Tier 3) collateral-free loan with 7% interest subvention.
components: Tier 1: ₹10,000 working capital loan
Tier 2: ₹20,000 (on timely repayment of Tier 1)
Tier 3: ₹50,000 (on timely repayment of Tier 2)
7% interest subvention via DBT (annual)
Cashback up to ₹100/month on digital transactions
Credit score building through repayment history

verificationNotes: Requires vending certificate or Letter of Recommendation from ULB.
Apply at banks, MFIs, or pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in.

requiredDocuments.name: Vending Certificate / Letter of Recommendation from ULB

schemes.name: Startup India — DPIIT Recognition & Benefits
schemes.shortDescription: DPIIT startup recognition unlocking tax holidays (3 years), self-certification under labour & environment laws, relaxed IP filing fees (80% discount), and Startup India Seed Fund access.

benefit.description: 3-year income tax holiday, 80% discount on IP fees, ₹20–50 lakh seed fund access (via SISFS).
components: Income Tax exemption for 3 consecutive years (Section 80-IAC)
Capital gains tax exemption on investment (Section 54EE)
80% concession on patent, trademark filing fees
Self-certification under 9 Labour and 3 Environment laws
Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS): ₹20L–₹50L grant/loan

verificationNotes: Startup must be incorporated/registered as Private Ltd, LLP, or Partnership.
Annual turnover should not exceed ₹100 crore for recognition eligibility.

schemes.name: PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan — Unorganized Worker Pension
schemes.shortDescription: ₹3,000/month assured pension at age 60 for unorganized sector workers (aged 18–40) contributing ₹55–₹200/month matched equally by Government.

benefit.description: ₹3,000/month (₹36,000/year) guaranteed pension starting at age 60. Government co-contributes equal amount.
components: ₹3,000/month guaranteed pension from age 60
Government matches your contribution 1:1
Monthly contribution: ₹55 (age 18) to ₹200 (age 40)
Family pension: 50% to spouse on subscriber's death
Enroll through CSC / bank with savings account

verificationNotes: Not eligible if covered by EPFO/ESIC/NPS or income-tax payer.
Monthly income from unorganized work should be ≤ ₹15,000.

requiredDocuments.name: Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Account

schemes.deadline: Always Open — enroll at CSC or maandhan.in

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY) — Guaranteed Pension for All
schemes.shortDescription: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 after age 60 for citizens aged 18–40 contributing a fixed amount. Government co-contributed 50% for first 5 years for eligible subscribers.

benefit.description: ₹1,000–₹5,000/month guaranteed pension at 60. Choose your pension level when joining.
components: ₹1,000 to ₹5,000/month guaranteed pension — citizen chooses level
Spouse receives same pension on subscriber's death
Nominee receives corpus (₹1.7L–₹8.5L) on both deaths
Income tax benefit under Section 80CCD
Join through any bank's savings account

verificationNotes: Must have a savings bank account and not be an income tax payer (for full GOI co-contribution).
Available at all banks — just walk in with Aadhaar & mobile number.
schemes.deadline: Always Open — apply at any bank

schemes.name: PM Kisan Maan-dhan — Farmer Pension Scheme
schemes.shortDescription: ₹3,000/month guaranteed pension at age 60 for small & marginal farmers aged 18–40, contributing ₹55–₹200/month matched equally by Government.

benefit.description: ₹3,000/month pension at 60 — Government co-contributes equal amount as farmer.
components: ₹3,000/month guaranteed pension after age 60
Government matches contribution 1:1
Monthly contribution varies from ₹55 (age 18) to ₹200 (age 40)
Family pension: 50% to spouse
Directly linked to PM-KISAN — PM-KISAN instalment can be used for premium

verificationNotes: Must be a small or marginal farmer (≤ 2 hectares cultivable land).
Excluded if covered by any other statutory social security scheme.
schemes.deadline: Always Open — enroll at CSC or maandhan.in

schemes.name: ADIP Scheme — Free Assistive Devices for Divyangjan
schemes.shortDescription: Free or subsidised assistive devices (wheelchairs, hearing aids, artificial limbs, Braille kits, smart canes, etc.) for persons with benchmark disability and income up to ₹20,000/month.
schemes.department: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / ALIMCO

benefit.description: Free assistive devices worth ₹5,000–₹30,000+ depending on type (wheelchair, hearing aid, artificial limb, etc.).
components: Free wheelchair (manual / motorised for severe disability)
Free hearing aid (digital BTE for hearing impairment)
Artificial limb / caliper / tricycle
Braille kits, magnifiers for visual impairment
Smart cane for blind persons
Devices distributed at assessment / fitment camps by ALIMCO

verificationNotes: Disability must be ≥40% (benchmark disability certificate required).
Income must be ≤ ₹20,000/month (family income for dependent).
Assessment camps organized by ALIMCO at district level.

requiredDocuments.name: Disability Certificate (≥40% benchmark)
requiredDocuments.note: Issued by CMHO / district disability board

schemes.deadline: Apply at ALIMCO camps or district social welfare office

schemes.name: PM MUDRA Yojana — Micro-Units Development & Refinance
schemes.shortDescription: Collateral-free institutional loans up to ₹10 lakh across Shishu (up to ₹50k), Kishore (₹50k–₹5L), and Tarun (₹5L–₹10L) for non-corporate micro/small enterprises.
schemes.department: Ministry of Finance / Department of Financial Services

benefit.description: Collateral-free business loan up to ₹10 lakh with flexible repayment terms through banks, NBFCs, and MFIs.
components: Shishu: Loans up to ₹50,000 for early-stage micro-ventures
Kishore: Loans from ₹50,000 up to ₹5,00,000 for equipment & working capital
Tarun: Loans from ₹5,00,000 up to ₹10,00,000 for established small businesses
Zero collateral required — credit guarantee provided by GOI
MUDRA Card provided for cash credit transactions

verificationNotes: Citizen must have a viable non-farm business or manufacturing/service proposal.
Apply through any commercial bank, RRB, Small Finance Bank, or udyamimitra.in portal.
schemes.deadline: Always Open — apply at any bank or udyamimitra.in
